items.title: Cu2S nanocrystals
paragraphs: 1.25 mmol ammonium diethyldithiocarbamate + 10 mL dodecanethiol + 17 mL oleic acid are the initial charge.
1 mmol copper(II) acetylacetonate in 3 mL oleic acid is a separately identified injected suspension, not a fully characterized stock solution.
110 °C initial temperature; rapid injection and heating; 180 °C growth for 10–20 min; natural cooling endpoint 120 °C. Do not assign 120 °C to centrifuge operation.
Centrifugation 4600 rpm for 10 min; retain precipitate/discard supernatant as reported. Never convert rpm to RCF without rotor.
Wash with 4 g toluene and 11 g isopropanol; retain gram units. Raw repeated-three-times wording remains unresolved, not unrolled as a certain three/four-cycle process.
Argon flow applies to initial heating; cleaning is in an Ar-protected glovebox with anhydrous solvents. Growth atmosphere beyond source wording remains unknown.

items.title: Separate Cu2S and CdS dispersions for device preparation
paragraphs: 15 mL pyridine per separate dispersion is a qualified reading of the prose; preserve that qualification.
120 °C for at least one day is a lower bound; appropriate hexane/chloroform amounts and stock concentrations stay unknown.
0.4 µm Teflon filter is equipment, not molecular reagent.
CdS growth is cited to reference 18 and was not inspected; do not create a CdS synthesis contribution.
Do not link the pyridine-exchanged stock to every Figure 1 specimen.

items.title: ITO-glass/PEDOT:PSS/Cu2S/CdS/Al photovoltaic device
paragraphs: 600 rpm casting belongs to device-film preparation, not Cu2S growth.
Do not distribute the ca. 30-minute ultrasound duration across separate baths as certain values.
The 150 nm/20 ohm-square ITO specification belongs to the glass branch.
PEDOT:PSS is an aqueous polymer formulation, not one resolved molecule; no exact composition or stock concentration.

Oxygen plasma and ITO-coated glass appear in protocol prose but are not separate complete entries in the 21-item inventory; map their equipment/material identities explicitly from existing evidence, not inferred molecular diagrams.
Approximate 1e-7 torr/up to 12 h vacuum hold is distinct from the subsequent high-vacuum Al deposition whose precise pressure is unknown.
Keep 300/100 nm layer thickness, roughness <4 nm and optical density 1.1 as specimen-context observations, not universal imposed deposition targets.

items.title: ITO-coated OC50-plastic/PEDOT:PSS/Cu2S/CdS/Al photovoltaic device
paragraphs: OC50 plastic replaces glass; oxygen-plasma duration 3.5 min. Do not silently copy glass ITO thickness/resistivity as measured plastic specifications.
105° is source curvature wording, not a bend radius.
Initial-flat and bent/released-flat values share a documented test lineage but lack an identified replicate/NC synthesis batch.

items.title: Author motivation
paragraphs: Cu2S is presented as an absorber with an approximately 1.21 eV bulk indirect gap and earth-abundant constituent elements; the authors revisit Cu2S/CdS after historic thin-film concerns about Cu diffusion and CdS doping, using mild solution processing.

items.title: Author interpretation
paragraphs: The authors attribute the interfacial electron barrier and some spectral/J-V behavior to Cu diffusion into CdS; this is an interpretation, not a direct measured diffusion profile here.

items.title: Author speculation
paragraphs: Some dodecanethiol capping ligand may survive film deposition and passivate traps or retard ion diffusion; the paper labels this as unpublished evidence/potential behavior, not a measured surface result.
